summary: Completed stricter backend-only readonly diagnostics (17 new executable tests) with deterministic clocks and real function-path assertions. No product code or live integrations were modified.

critical.issue: After delivery failure is persisted on message_logs, scheduler still skips resend when care_send_claims status remains sent/non-failed; claim gate is reached and blocks delivery.
Notifications moved to failed via persist_receipt (including 131047/131016) are not selected by drain query, so failed rows are never retried by queue drain.
Webhook period assignment uses receipt-time now/add_period(now) and has no event idempotency guard; replayed signed event overwrites current_period_start/end.
Charged event can set cancelled subscription back to active without status guard.
Delivery entitlement path does not call billing_access.access; with activation=true and payment_state.plan present, send proceeds even when access resolver reports allowed=false.

minor.issue: Unresolved audio media_url follows non-voice branch (is_voice=false, blank body) and STT is not invoked.
If first side-effect fails post-recording, duplicate retry bypasses second side-effect execution.
Updates latest category row for day, not exact older replied message_log_id context.
At Asia/Kolkata 22:01 with window_end 21:00, eligible gate suppresses warning path (positive control at 22:05 with end 23:00 reaches warning path).
Nitya medicine sync can validate 3 slots but schedule expansion emits 4 sends; at 20:00 with reminders already at quota, Med C send is skipped by quota branch.

action_items: Add explicit reconciliation between async receipt failures and care_send_claims status transitions.
Extend notification drain selector/policy for failed states with bounded retries where intended.
Harden billing webhook with event idempotency keying and provider-authoritative period boundaries/status checks.
Unify scheduler entitlement checks with billing_access.access to prevent plan/access divergence.
Bind reminder side-effects to exact reply context/message_log_id to prevent wrong-row mutation.
critical_code_review_comments: Current readonly suite proves several paths are executable regressions, not hypothetical source-only risks.
Webhook and scheduler state machines still diverge under async-failure/replay conditions.
Billing charged webhook trusts event timing over provider subscription period authority.
